claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Urapidil is a low-potency alpha1-adrenergic antagonist/5-HT1A agonist that is unlikely to kill cancer cells at 2.5 uM; any weak, non-selective antiproliferative effect would most plausibly reflect cationic amphiphilic lysosomal stress or general off-target cytotoxicity rather than adrenergic or serotonergic receptor modulation.
